findings.message: Design D7 and handoff H1 claim that setting `fetch-depth: 0` on the checkout of the `check` job lets the published build see the history ('deploy.yml calls this workflow, so the published build sees the history too'). But `.github/workflows/ci.yml:40-43` runs `git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin main` in 'Check data-only paths' before `pnpm build`. As far as I know, a `--depth=1` fetch into a full clone marks the fetched commit shallow, and on a push to main that commit is HEAD, so `git log` in resolveAppRevision again sees one commit. A data-only HEAD then gets the `unreadable-<instant>` value and shows a notice, so the app-delivery scenario 'The published build sees the history' and M2 fail in production. The H1 patch and README must also handle that step (e.g. fetch without --depth, or run the revision resolution against the unshallowed history), and D7 must say so.

Task 1.2's verification cannot pass as written: it expects `grep -rniE "version number|build number|auto-update" packages/client/src docs/glossary ...` to show these words 'only under *Never:*', but existing `docs/glossary/settings.md:11` (Deploy time) says 'a stand-in for a version number. ... *Not:* a version number.', which is not under *Never:*. No task updates the Deploy time entry, although the new App revision takes over its 'stand-in for a version number' role and lists 'version number' as a *Never:* word. Add a task (or extend 1.1/1.2) to change the Deploy time entry, or fix the verification.

Task 6.1 and design D6 plan `scripts/cityData/readDumpDate.ts` as new, but `packages/client/scripts/cityData/download.ts:86` already defines a function `readDumpDate` (it reads the dump date from the archive entry time), and `scripts/cityData/checkCityData.ts:46` already checks `source.dumpDate` of the committed file. The plan adds a second function with the same name for a related concept in the same module and splits dump-date validation from its existing check, without naming or adding a glossary owner for the 'date of the city data'. glossary.md says: 'Do not write a new function, type or constant for the same concept anywhere else' and 'A change that introduces a new domain concept adds its glossary entry in the same change'. Rename or merge it with the existing owner, and give the concept a glossary entry.

findings.message: FR8 names five kinds of difference ('the UTC offset, the abbreviation or the daylight-saving flag in force at the instant of the comparison, in any clock change after that instant, or in the rule for the years after the listed changes') and M3 promises '1 for each of the 5 kinds of difference of FR8', but the zone-rules-updates delta scenario 'Kinds of difference that count' lists a different five (offset, abbreviation, the instant of the March 2027 clock change, the offset that change starts, the future rule) and has no row for the daylight-saving flag. A flag-only difference (same offset and abbreviation, isDst changed) is untested, and task 5.1's 'covering the five kinds of difference' is ambiguous. Add a daylight-saving flag row to the scenario and make M3 and task 5.1 name the same kinds as FR8.

Task 5.3 says 'a work counter (`src/test/workCounters.ts`) counts compared zones', but `startWorkCount()` in src/test/workCounters.ts only exposes formatters, formattersByZone, displayNames, collators, transitionLookups, transitionLookupsByZone and normalizations: there is no counter of compared zones. The task neither says to add one nor how to observe per-zone comparisons inside `findChangedZones` (an internal call to `hasZoneRulesChangeFrom` in the same ES module cannot be spied with vi.spyOn). The NFR-P2 'Work bound' scenario ('at most 13 zones were compared, each once') therefore has no verifiable mechanism. Name the counter to add and how it counts (for example an injected comparison or a counted lookup on `ZoneRulesRelease.zones`).

findings.message: Tasks 2.2 and 6.1 add `APP_REVISION = __APP_REVISION__` and `CITY_DATA_DATE = __CITY_DATA_DATE__` to `src/constants/deploy.ts` and add the defines only to `vite.config.ts` and `vitest.config.ts` ("the define in both configs"). They miss `packages/client/playwright.bdd.config.ts`, which only does `Object.assign(globalThis, { [DEPLOY_INSTANT_DEFINE]: TEST_DEPLOY_INSTANT })` because, as its comment says, "The step files import `@/constants`, which reads the deploy instant that Vite defines in a build. Playwright has no Vite, so it gets the test instant." `src/constants/index.ts:20` re-exports from `./deploy`, so loading `@/constants` (config line 38 and every E2E step file) would throw a ReferenceError for `__APP_REVISION__` and `__CITY_DATA_DATE__`, and the Playwright verification commands of tasks 7.1 and 7.2 cannot pass. Add `playwright.bdd.config.ts` to tasks 2.2 and 6.1, setting both new globals from `TEST_APP_REVISION` and `TEST_CITY_DATA_DATE`.

design.md D6 contradicts itself on where `isDumpDate` lives. The first bullet says "`scripts/cityData/checkCityData.ts` exports `isDumpDate(value)`"; the third says "both functions live in `scripts/cityData/committedDumpDate.ts`, which `checkCityData.ts` imports", and task 6.1 also puts `isDumpDate` in `committedDumpDate.ts`. Pick one home for the validator so the concept keeps a single owner (glossary rule).

findings.message: tasks.md task 7.3 ('Re-approve the settings screenshots once, on Linux in Docker (the Mac run is expected to differ). Verify: the visual regression scenarios of the settings page pass in the Linux run …') names no command and relies on a Docker setup the repository does not have: packages/client/package.json has only "test:bdd:gen": "bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts", and no file outside this change mentions Docker for screenshots. The implement stage cannot follow or verify it, which fails 'each task independently verifiable and naming the automated test that proves it'. Rewrite it the way archived add-day-colouring-setting task 9.4 did: tag 'Approved screenshots of the settings at <width> px in the <theme> theme' in src/test/features/settings/settings_e2e.feature with '@apply-data-updates-silently @NFR-R1', run `npx playwright test -c playwright.bdd.config.ts --grep "Approved screenshots of the settings" --update-snapshots` after `pnpm run test:bdd:gen`, then run it again without --update-snapshots, then run the other approved screenshots (`--grep "Approved|Screenshot of the|screenshot"`) unchanged. Verify with those passing runs and with `git status --short src/test/features/__screenshots__` listing only the 8 settings PNGs (chromium and mobile-chrome, 375/1024 px, both themes).
